content.content: Create an event in the calendar for the family reunion based on the emails about it. Make the event last 4 hours.

```python
# Search for emails about the family reunion
family_reunion_emails = search_emails(query="family reunion", sender=None)

# If no emails found, try alternative search terms
if len(family_reunion_emails) == 0:
    family_reunion_emails = search_emails(query="reunion", sender=None)

# If still no results, try searching for "family"
if len(family_reunion_emails) == 0:
    family_reunion_emails = search_emails(query="family", sender=None)

# Check if we found any emails
if len(family_reunion_emails) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No emails found about the family reunion")

# Print the emails to see their content
for email in family_reunion_emails:
    print(f"From: {email.sender}")
    print(f"Subject: {email.subject}")
    print(f"Body: {email.body}")
    print("---")
```
